audience: Indonesian businesses and accountants that keep their books in Kledo

useCases.title: See which invoices are overdue
useCases.text: Read the aged receivable report and the sales invoices. Ask the assistant how much each customer owes and for how long.

useCases.title: Plan the vendor bills due soon
useCases.text: List the purchase invoices and read the aged payable report. Build a list of the bills to pay in the next 14 days.

useCases.title: Review profit and loss by month
useCases.text: Read the profit and loss report for a period. Compare months and ask the assistant to explain the main changes.

useCases.title: Check cash and bank balances
useCases.text: Read the balance of each cash and bank account. List the latest bank transactions and the cash flow report.

useCases.title: Prepare a month-end closing review
useCases.text: Read the trial balance, the balance sheet and the chart of accounts. Check them before you close the month.
